whole.says: An object of D7 is one large bundle of number-theoretic data together with the equations that tie the pieces to each other. It starts from integer parameters (a Ranks record R), a CM number field setting (a Host record with fields E and F, primes q, d, g 0, g 1, pde, pde' and a finite set of level primes), and families of Hermitian spaces over E. It then adds a second number field LL with its places and a finite set of words. There is one rational parameter record for each word and each element of a set Tau of size f, and each word also has a member made of column data, data at a prime T and a period map. On top of this it adds a determinant group Dt with characters that fix the values rhoDet and rhoDet', p-adic period rings for every prime l, a large package of Galois-representation and automorphic data (the N-stage records), Hermitian lattice forms, Haar measures on the groups U(P,Q), theta-jet data at chosen primes, and local data at good primes. Many of the fields are conditions that make these independently given pieces agree, and the group sections below say which fields hold data and which hold conditions.

groups.title: Ranks, host field, spaces and volumes
groups.gloss: R is a Ranks record of natural numbers k, m, t (k and m even, t odd, 2 ≤ m, m + 3 ≤ k, k + m − 1 + 5 ≤ t, 3m < t, m ≤ 2·ord ≤ k and m² ≤ k + m(t + 1)). host is a Host record over R that supplies a CM number field E together with two number fields that the code calls F and K, primes q and d, a number QS, two distinct level primes g 0 and g 1, two further level primes pde and pde' that leave remainder 1 on division by 15, and an ideal ccK. The field sp is a Spaces record over E, meaning a CM extension E over a totally real F of degree 2, a prime T, and Hermitian spaces X j, X', Y j, W j and V j over E with prescribed ranks, embeddings and signatures. The function vol gives each Hermitian space a real number, and vol_pos requires that number to be strictly positive.

groups.title: Row data and the base parameters
groups.gloss: what₂ is a Rows.Data record over R. It holds a field LL with an embedding embLL into the complex numbers and a system of places, a finite set Tau with exactly f elements, finite-dimensional complex inner product spaces such as EE (with Drows = (1 − delp)·Dall and delp ≤ 1), a type Word, and spaces Mu u, Amb μ and Mt μ j with lattices and self-adjoint idempotent operators. eTau is a bijection between Tau and a set the code calls R.Psi. hc assigns to each τ in Tau an HCParam record, which is a list u of k half-integers, a list v of k − 1 integers and lists b and e of m integers that interlace (v i < u i and u (i+1) < v i, and −b 0 < u (k−1)), with e j − b j ≥ (t + 3)/2 and b (j+1) − e j ≥ (t + 3)/2.

groups.title: Words and their parameters and members
groups.gloss: The set of words is finite, and u₀ is a chosen base word. The function hcW gives one HCParam record for each word u and each τ, and it agrees with hc at the base word. For every word the entries v, b and e are the same as those of hc, and so are the first entry u 0 and the last entry u (k−1) when k > 0, so only the inner entries of u may change from word to word. For each word, mem u is a Member made of three parts, a column chain C (finite class sets cls i with finite stabilizer groups whose orders divide a positive number DGam, values rhoDet and rhoDet' of absolute value 1 for i < m, and integers sSharp and sDiv given by the functions sExp' and sExp at e i and i + 1, which this reading takes to be e i − N(i+1)/2 and e i − N(i)/2), a ColumnsAtT record A (a prime T, a set vT of f elements, finite fields Fv of size T, nontrivial additive characters, a positive Dstar and a number GamP > 1) and a period map P.

groups.title: The field LL
groups.gloss: LL is a number field, that is a finite extension of the rational numbers, and it carries an involution called star. LL is totally complex and is a Galois extension of the rationals. The embedding embLL into the complex numbers sends star x to the complex conjugate of embLL x.

groups.title: Hermitian lattice data over LL
groups.gloss: div is a DivData record over LL indexed by the words. It consists of a Hermitian lattice RR, one lattice Nu u per word, linear maps Bk u from Nu u into the dual of RR, real numbers h u, HH, etaF and delP, and a natural number Dall, with delP ≤ 1 and HH at least the rank-weighted average of the differences between mu (Nu u) and h u plus RR.muMax. div_good requires that every matrix X v attached to RR and to each Nu u at each infinite place v has a determinant that is a unit, so that it is invertible.

groups.title: Embedding the host field into LL
groups.gloss: embE is a ring homomorphism from E to LL whose composite with embLL is the chosen complex embedding host.φ₀ of E. conjF is an F-linear field map of E equal to the map the code calls host.conj, and embE turns host.conj into star. LL0 is a subfield of LL that contains the image of E. Every element of the ring what₂.O maps to an algebraic integer of LL, and the image of every algebraic integer of E is hit by some element of what₂.O.

groups.title: Places of LL
groups.gloss: plEq is a bijection between the abstract places of what₂ and the nonzero prime ideals of the ring of integers of LL. For nonzero x, the valuation at a place w equals the w-adic order of x, defined as minus the logarithm of the multiplicative valuation (vAdd). The stored ramification index at w equals the ramification index of the prime over the integers (eWL), and the valuation of x at the conjugate place equals the valuation at w of star x.

groups.title: The prime T of each word
groups.gloss: For each word u, the prime T(u) of its member lies in the level primes of the host, and it equals π times host.conj π for an algebraic integer π of E lying in K with π − 1 divisible by QS·q·d·(g 0·g 1)². The prime of the spaces sp is T(u₀), and for each word there is a nonzero c in E with c·conj(c)·T(u) = T(u₀). Each T(u) lies between Tstar and (1 + 1/(f·k))·Tstar, where Tstar is a quantity the code calls (mem u).A.Tstar. GamP is the same for every word, T(u) differs from pde and from pde', and Dstar equals what₂.Dstar.

groups.title: Lattices for the column classes
groups.gloss: For each word u, each level i and each class c in cls i, clsLat gives a submodule over the ring of integers of E inside the space (sp.X i).V. clsLat_lat requires each of these to be a full lattice in that E-vector space, in the sense of Submodule.IsFullLattice.

groups.title: Identifications with period data
groups.gloss: eMu u is a complex-linear isomorphism from what₂.Mu u to a space the code calls Mram, and eMt u is a complex-linear isomorphism from the space Mt of the period map to Amb at the base tuple mu0. At the base tuple the pairing perCol equals a map the code calls PtilCol, read through these isomorphisms, and the pairing Bu is linear in each argument. For each tuple μ there is a twisted column chain chTw u μ that equals the member's chain at mu0, with linear isomorphisms e0Tw and eMtTw and a period map PTw. For μ different from mu0, perCol is again PtilCol of PTw, read through these identifications.

groups.title: Bases matching LL lattices with complex spaces
groups.gloss: jEE is an additive map from the LL-space of RR into EE that is semilinear with respect to embLL, meaning jEE(a x) = embLL(a)·jEE(x). It sends the basis of RR to a basis of the complex space EE, and in the same way jN u sends the basis of Nu u to a basis of Mu u. The numbers Dall and delP of div agree with Dall and delp of what₂.

groups.title: Determinant group and its characters
groups.gloss: Dt is a commutative group, detCls sends each class to Dt, muTil n and chiD are homomorphisms from Dt to the nonzero complex numbers, and chiD is trivial on a subgroup UO. e1Dt maps the unitary elements z of E (those with star z · z = 1) to Dt, and chiD(e1Dt z) is the product over τ in Tau of the inverse of host.emb(eTau τ)(z). For self-dual lattices in E^N (finitely generated, spanning, and equal to their dual for the form sum of star(x i)·y i), relDet gives an element of Dt/UO that is 1 on equal lattices, multiplies along chains L, L', L'' and equals the class of e1Dt(det γ) when L' is the image of L under a unitary matrix γ. Finally rhoDet i c equals muTil(i+1) of detCls to the power −1 times chiD of detCls to the power −⌊N(i+1)/2⌋, and rhoDet' i c equals muTil(i+1) of detCls times chiD of detCls to the power ⌊N(i)/2⌋.

groups.title: Positive weights on Tau
groups.gloss: dsig gives a real number for each element of Tau. dsig_pos requires every one of these numbers to be strictly positive.

groups.title: Cusp-span data
groups.gloss: s is an SData record built from R, F, E, conjF, the words, Tau and hcW. It holds a positive rational Del with consecutive v entries differing by exactly 4·Del, an injective letter map from words to sequences of k − 2 booleans with u(l+1) = v l − 1/2 − Del when the letter is true and v l − 1/2 otherwise, a finite-dimensional complex inner product space HH with spaces Cu u and maps into it, positive volumes, terms and pairs, and local field data atP at each prime of F with a degree 2 extension. The split datum at p is present exactly when the residue characteristic of p is g 0 or g 1, HH has complex dimension what₂.Dall, Cu u is linearly isomorphic to the member's space Mu0, and the places PlF correspond bijectively to the nonzero primes of the ring of integers of F.

groups.title: Local p-adic period theory
groups.gloss: loc gives a LocPrime record for every prime l. That is a pair of rings B and BdR with Galois actions, a Frobenius map φB, an element tB, a character χQ, period data for every finite extension of the l-adic numbers, compatible l-power roots of unity ζQ, and valuations normalised by v(l) = 1. For each l, locA adds actions on the completed algebraic closure and on its tilt, an element ε built from roots of unity, and an injective map from A_inf into B that respects the Galois action, Frobenius and the filtration. locT identifies B and BdR with the rings Bcris and BdR that the project builds from Witt vectors of the tilt, compatibly with the l-adic integers, the Galois actions, Frobenius, the filtrations, an element t that is a logarithm of the Teichmüller lift of ε, and A_inf.

groups.title: Galois and automorphic stage data
groups.gloss: nd is an NData record. It holds an algebraic closure Om of E and a set Loc of local indices i, each with a prime l i, a level j i with 1 ≤ j i ≤ m, and a complete discrete valuation ring O i finite over the l-adic integers. It also holds a local Hecke algebra acting faithfully on a free module, characters chi i c equal to chi i 1 times the cyclotomic character to the power −(c − 1) for 1 ≤ c ≤ t, sets S i and Q i of split places, sets PlG k of size f with monic labels of degree r, and the identity restRowsFiniteGroupCard = ∏ over k of |GL_r(ℤ/g k)|^f. ntw (NTw) gives twisting data with characters delta whose inertia image has exactly 15 elements at auxiliary places of norm ≡ 1 mod 15, naut (NAut) gives abstract local parameters with dimension, sums, twists and Frobenius eigenvalues together with automorphic objects CG a, nbc (NBC), nexp (NExp) and nth (NTh) give base-change, expansion and theta data, and ntypes (NTypes) gives an abelian extension Mray of K unramified outside primes dividing QS·q·d, with g k ≡ 1 mod QS·q·d and multisets bc with sum of a·d equal to r. The two remaining fields require a condition that the code calls ntypes.IdempotentMatchesAction and require embLL(eLL0 g) to equal the coefficient at g of an element the code calls ntypes.e0.

groups.title: Local bridges at primes above l
groups.gloss: For each local index i and each prime w of E above l i, nbr gives a LocBridge. That is a finite extension Kw of the l-adic numbers in which E is dense, an embedding j of Om into the algebraic closure of the l-adic numbers, a continuous isomorphism between the decomposition group at w and the Galois group of Kw, and a larger extension LL containing all conjugates of Kw whose ring of integers is isomorphic to O i. nbr_ind requires x to lie in the valuation ring at w exactly when |j x| ≤ 1, and self_good requires every root of unity whose order divides lcm(l, host.condN) to lie in that LL. ntwbr and ntwbr_ind give the same kind of bridge, with the same condition, for the twist indices and the rings O0.

groups.title: Tie conditions between stages
groups.gloss: The field loc_tie requires that iotaOQ agrees with the bridge map toLL, and that the NAut predicates the code calls IsCrysW, IsdRW and IsPotCrysW and the jump multisets jumpsW agree, through the local bridges and loc, with the bridge notions the code calls IsCrysW, IsdRW, IsPotCrysW, IsJumpW and multW and with their versions IsCrysE, IsdRE, IsPotCrysE, IsJumpE and multE over larger finite extensions. bc_tie requires bc σ to equal the multiset of pairs (a, d) for any matching parameter list whose automorphic pieces satisfy a condition the code calls csd and an integrality condition, and rbar_tie requires rbar to be semisimple with characteristic polynomials that reduce correctly. mtpar_tie requires MtPar to be the span of the matching typeV spaces, and Z i and Zgood i equal the explicitly defined sets ZN and ZgoodN (points whose parameter list contains the part (1, muC i twisted by etaTinv, t)). For 1 ≤ j ≤ m, etaJ_tie requires etaJ j w to equal the sum of a quantity the code calls nd.etaLoc over the local indices with level j and place w.

groups.title: Hermitian forms of members and isometries
groups.gloss: fm u is a MemberForms record for member u. It holds vector spaces of dimension N i over the fields Fv, dominant integer weights lam given by an explicit formula from hc, Hermitian lattices lat i over LL embedded in the class-function spaces with matching norms, and nonnegative reals beOn and thFree. The inner product on Mu u equals a form the code calls ipC 0, read through eMu, and the same holds for Cu u through s_Cu. nuIn u is an injective LL-linear map from the lattice space of Nu u into the space of lat 0, with image a subspace the code calls ramSub, compatible with jN and eMu, and preserving the coordinate norm normAt at every infinite place, while jEE preserves norms at the infinite place of embLL and sEE is a conjugate-linear isometric embedding of EE into s.HH.

groups.title: Haar measures on unitary groups
groups.gloss: cd is a CDHaar record giving a Haar measure on each group U(P,Q) of complex matrices preserving the form with matrix diag(1 for P entries, −1 for Q entries). The measure on U(N,0) is a probability measure. For each P and Q there is one constant c, neither 0 nor infinite, that is the limiting density near the identity of both cd P Q and cd (P+Q) 0 against a Lebesgue-normalised measure on the Lie algebra.

groups.title: Theta-jet sites
groups.gloss: jet is a ThetaJet record with sites of two kinds. A site of the first kind carries a prime l ≥ 5, an even d ≥ 2, ranks N0 = N(jOf − 1) and N1 = N(jOf) with 1 ≤ jOf ≤ m, and a power series in variables indexed by ℤ/d × {0..N0−1} × {0..N1−1}, and a site of the second kind has d replaced by 1, the host class of l equal to the inert class, and a condition HNeZero that fails. For each site of the first kind the fields choose a word, a class at level jOf − 1 and a class at level jOf of that word's chain, a place of LL whose residue characteristic is the site's prime l, and a map from ℤ/d into Tau. Sites of the second kind get the same choices, with one element of Tau instead of a map.

groups.title: Extra global data and local data at good primes
groups.gloss: gx is a GlobalExtra record giving strictly positive reals Om τ s and thOne s for each τ and each complex embedding s of LL. For each word u and place w whose residue characteristic p satisfies GIdx (p prime, p ≥ 5, inert class, HNeZero, p not a level prime and p not dividing T(u)), gat gives a GAtP record at p, which is a discrete valuation ring with fraction field, place data satisfying HidaSetting, and a number e. The field gat_d requires a quantity named d to equal the complex dimension of the member's space Mu0. The file gives no body for this d, and d is a different number from the field e of GAtP.

groups.title: Signature of the spaces Y j
groups.gloss: For every j ≤ m and every complex embedding τ of E, the signature of the Hermitian space sp.Y j at τ is the pair sigYD R j. That pair is (rankY j − ⌊(m − j)/2⌋, ⌊(m − j)/2⌋), where rankY is a rank the code calls R.rankY.

numbers: In D7, vol_pos requires vol W > 0 for every Hermitian space W, and dsig_pos requires dsig ρ > 0.
In D7, T_norm requires π − 1 to be divisible by QS·q·d·(g 0·g 1)².
In D7, T_win requires Tstar ≤ T(u) ≤ (1 + 1/(f·k))·Tstar for every word u.
In D7, hcW_first and hcW_last fix the entries of u at index 0 and at index k − 1 when 0 < k.
In D7, rhoDet_eq_inv_muTilde_chiD_pow uses the exponent −⌊N(i+1)/2⌋ on chiD and the index i + 1 on muTil, and rhoDetPrime_eq_muTilde_mul_chi_pow uses the exponent ⌊N(i)/2⌋.
In D7, etaJ_tie applies for 1 ≤ j ≤ m, and Y_sigval applies for j ≤ m.
In D7, jetL uses the level jOf i − 1 and jetL1 uses the level j1Of i − 1.
In Ranks, k and m are even, t is odd, 2 ≤ m, m + 3 ≤ k, k + m − 1 + 5 ≤ t, 3m < t, m ≤ 2·ord, 2·ord ≤ k and m² ≤ k + m(t + 1).
In HCParam, e j − b j ≥ (t + 3)/2 and b(j+1) − e j ≥ (t + 3)/2, each u i is an integer plus 1/2, and v, b and e are integers.
In Host, QS ≤ n², o^64 ≤ 2^e, q ≠ 3, and 4·t·r + 1 is less than both q and d.
In Host, every odd prime p ≤ splitBound has Jacobi symbol (−d/p) = 1, and every odd prime l dividing QS satisfies 4·l ≤ splitBound.

In Host, pde and pde' leave remainder 1 on division by 15, the norm of ccK is coprime to 2, 3, 5, q, d, QS and all level primes, and ccK is not contained in the ideal generated by any integer greater than 1.
In Host, 2 ≤ Lw and every s in T2 satisfies 4·Lw·s < n0, and NoRel forbids relations with integer coefficients i, j satisfying 0 < |i| ≤ Lw and 0 < |j| ≤ Lw.
In HostRaw, 2 ≤ e, 0 < QS, 2^(e+2) divides QS, QS is coprime to q·d, and the cyclotomic field used has conductor QS·q·d.
In HostHyp, q and d are primes with q ≡ 3 mod 8, d ≡ 7 mod 16 and Jacobi symbol (−d/q) = 1.

In HostDer, E has degree 4·ord over the rationals, F has degree 2·ord, the CM type has 2·ord elements, the discriminant of E is the square of that of F, 2^(e + 1 − 2^(−e))·√d ≤ rd ≤ (QS/2)·√(q·d) and 4·ord ≤ rd².
In GIdx, the prime p must satisfy 5 ≤ p.
In ColumnChain, DGam > 0 and the values rhoDet and rhoDet' have absolute value 1 for i < m.
In ColumnsAtT, vT has f elements, each field Fv has T elements, duStar > 0, Dstar > 0 and GamP > 1.
In DivData, delP ≤ 1.
In Rows.Data, Tau has f elements, delp ≤ 1, Drows = (1 − delp)·Dall, restRowsFiniteGroupCard > 0, and etaJ and shaLen are nonnegative.
In Rows.Places, every ramification index is positive.

In MemberForms, the spaces lv and lk have dimension N i, the weight sg has length N m − 1, the formula for lam uses blocks of size t + 1 after the first k entries, and beOn and thFree are nonnegative.
In wG, the weight is e j − k/2 − (2j − 1)(t + 1)/2, and in rhoVec the shift is (N − 1)/2 − i.
In Spaces, X j has rank N j for j ≤ m, W j has rank r and V j has rank nV for 1 ≤ j ≤ m, zm has Hermitian norm −T, and the hyperbolic pairs pair to 1.
In CMData and in LocAt, the extension has degree 2.

In NData, sha_eq applies for 0 < e < t, 1 ≤ j i ≤ m, chi_def applies for 1 ≤ c ≤ t with exponent −(c − 1), s0 i = max(1, exponent of l i in QS) for odd l i, T_gen uses 1 ≤ k ≤ nV, PlG k has f elements, and the labels have degree r.

In NTw, the inertia image of delta has exactly 15 elements, places in pD have norm ≡ 1 mod 15, chi1 raised to the power g k − 1 is trivial at tame places, zk is a primitive l^k-th root of unity, and 1 ≤ jS ≤ m and 1 ≤ jL ≤ m.
In NTh, aL equals 1 when l i is some g k and 0 otherwise, and hk_ev applies for 1 ≤ k ≤ r.
In NBC, satAU has nV/2 elements and infW has nV elements, each an integer plus (nV − 1)/2.
In NAut, etaT has Frobenius eigenvalue −1 at non-split places, regular algebraic parameters are integers plus (a − 1)/2, and chi_mu uses the twist (t − 1)/2 + (1 − nV)/2.

In NTypes, every g k ≡ 1 mod QS·q·d, Mray is unramified outside primes dividing QS·q·d, the pairs in bc σ have positive entries with sum of products equal to r, and the polynomials in labPar and eSer have degree r.
In heckePol, the polynomial has degree nV and uses the power k(k − 1)/2 of the norm.
In JetLoc and JetLoc1, the prime l satisfies 5 ≤ l, and in JetLoc d is even with 2 ≤ d.
In ThetaJet, 1 ≤ jOf i ≤ m and 1 ≤ j1Of i ≤ m.

In SData, Del > 0, consecutive v entries differ by 4·Del, the letter sequences have length k − 2, u(l+1) = v l − 1/2 − Del or v l − 1/2, all scales and volumes are positive, and points live in dimension rS + 1.
In sigYD, the signature is (rankY j − ⌊(m − j)/2⌋, ⌊(m − j)/2⌋).
In CDHaar, the density constant c is neither 0 nor infinite.
In HidaSetting, 5 ≤ p, n' is even with 2 ≤ n', the residue ring has p^n' elements and w² = p.
In LocPrime and LocAinf, v(l) = 1, ζ 0 = 1, ζ 1 ≠ 1, and χQ agrees with an integer up to l^(−m).
In PeriodData, t lies in Fil 1 and not in Fil 2, and φ t = p·t.
In GoodCoef, the roots of unity considered have order dividing lcm(l, N).
In IsGood, the polynomials have degree N, for every a with 1 ≤ a and 2a ≤ N some polynomial has no factor of degree a, and some irreducible factor has prime degree q with N < 2q and q + 3 ≤ N.
In Exc, a prime ℓ counts as exceptional when g^d < ℓ^(4·v), where v is the exponent of ℓ in g^d − 1, and BB uses 1 ≤ d ≤ N.
whole.suggests: As a suggestion only, the names hint that D7 is the full set of hypotheses for one step of a large argument, the step named in its module RhoDetPrimeEqMuTildeMulChiPow, which writes the column values rhoDet and rhoDet' as values of characters on a determinant group. The names Host, cmType, Psi and condN suggest a CM field with a CM type and a conductor, and the period-ring names (Ainf, Bcris, BdR, LocTied) suggest Fontaine's p-adic Hodge theory. The N-stage names (heckePol, frobEig, IsCrysW, csd and the Speh-style sums) suggest Galois representations attached to conjugate self-dual automorphic representations of unitary groups. The names ThetaJet, HCParam and CDHaar, together with the Hermitian lattices, suggest theta lifts and harmonic-analysis estimates, but the file gives no bodies for many of these names, so these readings remain guesses.
errors: Reading A says that gat_d requires the number e of the GAtP record to equal the complex dimension of Mu0, but the Lean text of gat_d reads (gat u w h).d = Module.finrank ℂ (mem u).A.Mu0, so it constrains a quantity d, and the GAtP structure shown in all.md has a field e and no field d.

Reading A calls the conditions in loc_tie the crystalline, de Rham and potentially crystalline predicates and Hodge-Tate jumps, but the Lean text only names the abstract NAut fields IsCrysW, IsdRW, IsPotCrysW and jumpsW and the LocBridge members IsCrysW, IsdRW, IsPotCrysW, IsJumpW, multW, IsCrysE, IsdRE, IsPotCrysE, IsJumpE and multE, and all.md shows no body that gives them these meanings.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.CDHaar
definitions.gloss: A record that gives, for every pair of natural numbers P and Q, a measure cd P Q on the space UpqT P Q, together with three conditions. Each of these measures is a Haar measure, and cd N 0 is a probability measure for every N. For every P and Q there is a constant c, neither 0 nor infinity, such that both cd P Q and cd (P + Q) 0 satisfy OmegaDensity with that same constant c.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.ColumnChain
definitions.gloss: A record, depending on ranks R, a finite index type ι and a family hc of HCParam values, that holds a chain of data indexed by natural numbers i. It has finite class types cls i, finite stabilizer groups stab i c whose orders all divide a positive natural number DGam for i at most R.m, types Y i with nonzero complex numbers de, complex values rhoDet and rhoDet' of absolute value 1 for i below R.m, and complex-linear unfolding maps from functions on Y i to functions on Y (i + 1). It also has integer families sSharp and sDiv that equal sExp' R ((hc τ).e i) (i + 1) and sExp R ((hc τ).e i) (i + 1) respectively, for every i below R.m.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.DivData
definitions.gloss: A record over a number field K with a star operation and a finite type of words. It has a Hermitian lattice datum RR, a Hermitian lattice datum Nu u for each word u, K-linear maps Bk u from the space of Nu u into the dual of the space of RR, and real numbers h u. It also has a real number HH that is at least sFrame Nu h plus RR.muMax, a real number etaF, a natural number Dall, and a real number delP at most 1.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.G0g
definitions.gloss: Given an NData record N, this is the type of functions that send each pair made of k in Fin 2 and a place v in N.PlG k to an invertible R.r by R.r matrix over the integers modulo H.g k. It is a product of general linear groups over the finite fields ZMod (H.g k).

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.GIdx
definitions.gloss: For a host H and natural numbers T and p, the proposition that p is a prime, p is at least 5, H.cls p equals inertClass, HNeZero H p holds, p does not lie in H.levelPrimes, and p does not divide T.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.GlobalExtra
definitions.gloss: A record over a number field LL and a type Tau with two families of positive real numbers. The first gives a value Om τ s for every τ in Tau and every ring embedding s of LL into ℂ. The second gives a value thOne s for every such embedding s.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.HCParam
definitions.gloss: A record of rational parameters for ranks R. It has four tuples u of length R.k, v of length R.k - 1, and b and e of length R.m, subject to interlacing conditions (each v i lies strictly between u (i + 1) and u i), the condition that -b 0 is less than the last u, and gap conditions that e j - b j and b (j + 1) - e j are at least (R.t + 3)/2. Every e, v and b entry is an integer and every u entry is an integer plus 1/2.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.HSpace
definitions.gloss: A record for a Hermitian space over a number field E with a star operation. It has a finite-dimensional E-vector space V that is also a module over the ring of integers, a symmetric nondegenerate form hT that is conjugate-linear in its first argument and linear in its second, a natural number rank equal to the dimension, and a basis frame. It also has a signature pair of natural numbers for each embedding of E into ℂ, and a lattice L0 over the ring of integers that is unimodular for hT.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Host
definitions.gloss: A record that extends the host axioms HostAx for the frame of R with about fifty further fields. These include a square root sqq of -q with a prescribed Galois action, the bounds QS at most R.n squared and o to the power 64 at most 2 to the power R.e, q different from 3, q and d larger than 4 R.t R.r + 1, a split bound for small primes, a CM-type embedding φ₀, an ideal 𝔟 whose product with its conjugate is the different ideal, and a finite set levelPrimes. They also include two distinct level primes g 0 and g 1, two distinct level primes pde and pde' congruent to 1 modulo 15, a nonzero primitive ideal ccK of 𝓞 K with split and coprimality conditions, and the auxiliary data TT, T2, u0, Lw at least 2, a range bound 4 Lw s < R.n0, NoRel T2 Lw, and a real number CT2.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.GoodCoef
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, a natural number N and a finite extension LL of the l-adic numbers inside Om l, the proposition that every element x of Om l with x raised to the power lcm(l, N) equal to 1 lies in LL. In words, LL contains all roots of unity of order dividing lcm(l, N).

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.LocAinf
definitions.gloss: A record attached to a prime l and a LocPrime datum P. It has an absolute Galois group action on the l-adic complex numbers that extends the action on Om l and preserves norms, a compatible action on the tilt OCb l, and a compatible system ζ of l-power roots of unity in OC l with ζ 0 = 1 and ζ 1 ≠ 1. It also has the element ε of the tilt built from ζ and an injective ring map ιA from Ainf l into P.R.B that commutes with the Galois action and Frobenius. Further conditions describe the images of ιA in filtration degrees 0 and 1 and the images of Teichmüller lifts.
second_errors: B says the injective ring map ιA agrees with P.ζQ, but the Lean field ζ_eq says that the sequence ζ m in OC l equals P.ζQ m, and it says nothing about ιA.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.LocBridge
definitions.gloss: A record that links a global field extension Ω of E and a subgroup Gw of its Galois group to local l-adic data. It has a finite extension Kw of the l-adic numbers, a ring map j from Ω to Om l that sends E into Kw with dense image, and a bicontinuous group isomorphism e from Gw to the Galois group GK Kw that is compatible with j. It also has a second finite extension LL containing all conjugates of Kw and a bicontinuous ring isomorphism eO from O to the ring OL LL that respects the ℤ_[l]-algebra structure.
second_errors: B says the record has fifteen fields, but the Lean text lists fourteen fields, namely Kw, j, j_E, j_dense, e, e_cont, e_symm_cont, e_comm, LL, LL_split, eO, eO_alg, eO_cont and eO_symm_cont.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.LocTheory
definitions.gloss: The type of functions that assign to every prime l a LocPrime l datum.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.LocTied
definitions.gloss: A record that ties a LocPrime datum P and a LocAinf datum AI to the concrete period rings of the Per namespace. It has ring isomorphisms eB from P.R.B to Per.Bcris l and eD from P.R.BdR to Per.BdR l, with conditions saying that they respect l-adic integers, elements of Om l, Galois actions, Frobenius, the inclusion of B into BdR, the filtrations, the element tB as a logarithm of AI.ε, and the map ιA.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Member
definitions.gloss: A record for ranks R and a family hc of HCParam values indexed by a finite type. It has three fields, a ColumnChain C, a ColumnsAtT datum A for C, and a PeriodMap P for C.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.MemberForms
definitions.gloss: A record of about sixty fields that adds forms and lattice data to a column chain C, a ColumnsAtT datum A and a period map P over a number field LL. It has vector spaces lv and lk over the finite fields A.Fv v of dimension R.N i, nonzero functionals and vectors on them, a dilation action of units on the classes with compatibility conditions, a bijection tauOf for each place, dominant weights lam whose entries are given by hcToWeightQ and wG from hc, subspaces Fi with Fi 0 = A.Mu0, and Hermitian lattices lat i with embeddings matching norms given by majAt. It also has local lattices Bw over intW, a finite class type clsP with injective stabilizer maps, a point lattice ptLat with its embedding, and nonnegative real functions beOn and thFree.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NAut
definitions.gloss: A record of about one hundred fields that supplies an automorphic and Galois dictionary for an NData record N. It has embeddings of the coefficient fields into Qbar and ℂ, a type LP w of local parameters at each place w with dimension, sum, twist, character twist and unramified constructors, predicates mono0, unr and tempered, Frobenius eigenvalue multisets, inertia polynomials and inertial characteristic polynomials, together with algebraic laws relating them. It also has global objects CG a with local components, infinity types, twists and conjugate self-duality, characters muC, etaT and etaTinv, automorphic types AV with spaces typeV that decompose what₂.Mt, local Galois parameters wdOf of representations with conditions at places away from and above l, Hodge–Tate jump data, the character condition chi_mu and residue field maps kFbar.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NBC
definitions.gloss: A record of base-change data for an NAut record A. It has types AU j of automorphic objects with multiplicities, spherical predicates, local parameters, and Satake multisets of size R.nV / 2, types Wt j of weights whose infinity types are multisets of R.nV distinct complex numbers of the form integer plus (R.nV - 1)/2, and a weight map. It also has injective maps embAV from A.AV i into AU (N.j i) that preserve local parameters, Satake data, sphericity at nonsplit places and infinity weights.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NData
definitions.gloss: A record of about eighty fields that gives Hecke and Galois data for ranks R, a host H and row data what₂. It has an algebraic closure Om of H.E with places and local data, a link between Sha lengths and what₂.shaLen, a type Loc of indices i with primes l i, levels j i between 1 and R.m, tuples and places, complete discrete valuation rings O i finite over ℤ_[l i], finite sets X i with local separating Hecke algebras T i acting faithfully on free modules Mt i, and continuous characters chi i c. It also has finite sets Z and Zgood, exponents s0, disjoint finite sets S i and Q i of split places with generating Hecke operators, decomposition elements gam0, modules Bj, types PlG k of size R.f with monic polynomial labels of degree R.r, units chiT, and a cardinality identity for what₂.restRowsFiniteGroupCard.
second_errors: B says NData has about one hundred fields, but the Lean text has about eighty fields counting instance arguments and fewer without them.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NExp
definitions.gloss: A record of explicit form data over an NData record N and an NTw record tw. It has finite-dimensional vector spaces Fm i j b over the fraction field of tw.O i with an action of G0g N, a subgroup U with characters psiU, central idempotents eAlg in the group algebra defined through eLL0, lattices Bsup, and data types Dat with theta vectors, levels and twisted versions thPsi and thU. It also has twisting maps twPsi and twDel, characters delU into DelQM with conditions on ramification, conjugation and restriction, finitely generated spanning lattices MtLat in spaces MtV with maps thP, Hecke operators hkF, injective embeddings embB from tw.B, and idempotents eH.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NTh
definitions.gloss: A record of evaluation and theta data over NData, NTw and NExp records. It has embeddings iC of the coefficient fields into the l-adic complex numbers whose norm is at most 1 exactly on integral elements, integers aL, point sets Pt with injective evaluation maps ev, lattices Lt, harmonic polynomials Harm defined by vanishing of contracted second derivatives, and theta functions thV linear in both arguments. It also has reciprocity elements recDet and recDetq with group actions actK satisfying compatibility with characters, Hecke correspondences expressed through hkMove and hkU for split places, and an unramified subgroup FmUr with Bsup equal to the span of its elements whose evaluations have norm at most 1.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NTw
definitions.gloss: A record of about one hundred twenty fields that gives twisting data over an NData record N. It has a CM conjugation cc on N.Om, a type Tw of indices i with primes l i, discrete valuation rings O0 i ⊆ O i ⊆ Ok i k with Ok i k containing a primitive l i ^ k-th root of unity, two embeddings of LL0 related by conjugation, a set pD i equal to the places over pde' or pde, and a character delta i ramified exactly at pD i with inertia image of size 15. It also has twist characters chi1 with ramification conditions, representations rhoS, excluded place sets S0, modules B with lattices Theta and Hecke operators, characters lamG with values Xv and square roots qs, ray class groups RCG with surjective Artin maps and a universal property, theta values, and maps twOf, twist₂ and psiL with chi_tw expressing N.chi a 1 as a twisted chi1 times psiL a.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.NTypes
definitions.gloss: A record of type data over an NAut record A. It has an abelian Galois number field Mray over H.K unramified outside primes dividing QS q d, with both g k totally split and g k ≡ 1 modulo QS q d, disjoint sets BB, multisets bc of positive pairs summing to R.r, residual representations rbar with open kernel, tame generators tg with residue field maps iota and Teichmüller maps teichC, and conditions relating inertia polynomials and the characters chi to these. It also has central orthogonal idempotents eSer summing to 1, central actions cenAmb and cenMt, and a parameter type Par with monic degree R.r labels labPar, local parameters locPar of dimension R.r and subspaces MtPar and AmbPar.
second_errors: B says NTypes has about fifty fields, but the Lean text has about forty fields.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.PeriodMap
definitions.gloss: A record attached to a column chain C. It has three complex vector spaces Mt, Wz and Wrow, a linear map evz from functions on C.cls R.m × C.Y R.m to Wz, a linear map lowerMap from Wz to Wrow, and a bilinear pairing period between Wrow and Mt with values in ℂ.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Ranks
definitions.gloss: A record that extends a Frame with three natural numbers k, m and t. It requires k and m even, t odd, m at least 2, m + 3 at most k, k + m - 1 + 5 at most t, 3 m less than t, m at most 2 ord, 2 ord at most k, and m squared at most k + m (t + 1).

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Rows.Data
definitions.gloss: A record of about one hundred fields describing row data for ranks R. It has a field LL with an embedding into ℂ and places, a ring O mapping to LL, a finite type Tau of size R.f, a type Tup of tuples with distinguished elements and place-dependent tuples, finite-dimensional complex inner product spaces EE and EE0 with orthonormal bases and dimension relation Drows = (1 - delp) Dall, a finite type FT, and families of inner product spaces Amb, Mult, Mu, Mj and Mt with lattices, isometries, self-adjoint idempotents and linear maps between them. It also has a positive natural number restRowsFiniteGroupCard, a type Word with unit families ze equal to 1 at mu0, integer families kaBig, kaSmall, Ij and jw, real or rational functions lamP, etaJ and shaLen with the last two nonnegative, and LL-structures MtL with embeddings jMt.
second_errors: B calls Ij and jw real and rational families, but the Lean text gives Ij and jw the type Tup → ℕ → places.Pl → ℤ, so they are integer valued.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.SDLat
definitions.gloss: The type of submodules L over the ring of integers of E inside E^N that satisfy IsSDLat E N L.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.SDLat.smulLat
definitions.gloss: Given an N by N matrix γ over E and a submodule L of E^N over the ring of integers of E, this is the image of L under the linear map given by multiplication by γ, viewed as a submodule over the ring of integers.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Spaces
definitions.gloss: A record of Hermitian spaces over a CM extension E of F for ranks R. It has CMData, a prime T, definite spaces X j of rank R.N j, a space X' that embeds isometrically into X R.m orthogonally to an anisotropic vector z, spaces Y j with isometric embeddings of X j for j below R.m and an isometry from X' to Y R.m, and in Y 0 a vector zm of norm -T orthogonal to X 0 and a hyperbolic family hypE, hypF of size R.rS orthogonal to both. It also has a fixed signature for Y 0, spaces W j of rank R.r and signature R.sigW j related to Y 0 by a finite adelic similarity, and spaces V j of rank R.nV whose base lattice is orthonormal for plus or minus the form.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.ThetaJet
definitions.gloss: A record of jet data for ranks R and a host. It has a type Sit of situations, each with a JetLoc whose prime has class signal or inertClass, an index jOf between 1 and R.m, and ranks N0 and N1 equal to R.N (jOf i - 1) and R.N (jOf i). It also has a second type Sit1 of situations with JetLoc1 data whose prime has class inertClass and fails HNeZero, with an index j1Of between 1 and R.m and the same rank conditions.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.eWL
definitions.gloss: For a number field K and a nonzero prime w of its ring of integers, the ramification index of the ideal of w over ℤ, as a natural number.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.placesOver
definitions.gloss: For a number field E and a natural number p, the set of nonzero primes v of the ring of integers of E whose ideal contains p.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.sigYD
definitions.gloss: For ranks R and a natural number j, the pair of natural numbers (R.rankY j - (R.m - j)/2, (R.m - j)/2), where the divisions are natural-number divisions.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.vAdd
definitions.gloss: For a nonzero prime w of a Dedekind domain and an element x of its fraction field, the integer equal to minus the logarithm of the w-adic valuation of x. This is the additive valuation of x at w.

definitions.name: Formalism.HermitianLatticesTheory.normAt
definitions.gloss: For a basis b, a family X of complex matrices indexed by the infinite places, an infinite place v and a vector x, the real number cnorm (fcoord b X v x). This is the Euclidean length of the coordinate vector of x at v multiplied by the inverse of X v.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.GAtP
definitions.gloss: A record attached to a natural number p. It has a discrete valuation ring O with an algebra map to a field Kf, a Places datum P for p, O and Kf, a finite type comp with a Level datum for P at each element, and a natural number e.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.BcTie
definitions.gloss: For an NTypes record X, the proposition that for every index i, every σ and every list Sig satisfying HasParamW N A i σ Sig, where every member is conjugate self-dual and has infinity types made of distinct numbers of the form integer plus (R.r - p.d)/2, the multiset X.bc σ equals the multiset of pairs (p.a, p.d) taken from Sig.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.LocTie
definitions.gloss: For a LocTheory L and a family nbr of LocBridge data at each index i and each place w over N.l i, the proposition that, at every such i and w, the map iotaOQ agrees with the bridge map toLL. It also requires that for every continuous representation ρ of the Galois group, over N.O i or over a finite extension LL' containing the bridge field, the crystalline, de Rham and potentially crystalline conditions of A agree with the corresponding bridge conditions on the restriction to the decomposition group. Finally, for compatible embeddings τ and τ', the Hodge–Tate jumps of A must agree with the bridge jumps and multiplicities whenever the de Rham condition holds.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.MtParTie
definitions.gloss: For an NTypes record X, the proposition that for every index i and every parameter σ' the subspace X.MtPar (N.mu i) (N.j i) σ' equals the sum of the spaces A.typeV i P. The sum runs over those P for which some list Sig has isoLoc equal to X.locPar σ' at every place and makes IsBCV hold for P and the twist by A.etaTinv of Sig followed by muPart.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.RbarTie
definitions.gloss: For an NTypes record X, the proposition that for every index i, parameter σ, list Sig and representation ρ into R.r by R.r invertible matrices over N.O i with HasParamW N A i σ Sig and IsRepOfSig N A i Sig ρ, the residual representation X.rbar σ (N.w i) is semisimple. It also requires that for every group element g its characteristic polynomial, transported by fbCast, equals the reduction of the characteristic polynomial of ρ g through the residue map and A.kFbar i.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.ZN
definitions.gloss: For data N, an automorphic package A over N, and a local index i, this is the set of points x of N.X i for which there is some P with A.ptV i P equal to some x, together with some Pa such that IsBCV N A i P Pa holds and Pa contains the part with first entry 1, middle entry the twist A.tw (A.muC i) A.etaTinv, and last entry R.t.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.ZgoodN
definitions.gloss: For N, A and a local index i, this is the subset of ZN N A i made of the points x for which some parameter list Sig satisfies both HasParamX N A i x Sig and goodSig N A Sig.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.S.Draft.SData
definitions.gloss: A record type, depending on ranks R, number fields F and E with E an algebra over F, an F-algebra map sig from E to E, types Word and Tau, and a map hc from Word and Tau to HCParam R, that has 42 fields. They include positive scale constants cdScale and a positive rational Del, a condition that consecutive v-entries of hc w τ differ by 4 * Del, an injective letter map from words to Boolean strings of length R.k - 2 with a formula fixing the u-entries as v minus 1/2 minus Del when the letter is true, finite-dimensional complex inner product spaces HH and Cu u with linear maps Pu into HH, positive volumes volN and volH, types of terms and pairs between words with operators, predicates, complex and real values, an element Gterm of F, local data atP of type LocAt at every height-one prime of the ring of integers of F, points ptOf in Point E (R.rS + 1), and a real-valued meanCount.
second_errors: B says SData has about sixty fields, but the Lean text lists exactly 42 fields, running from cdScale to meanCount.
B calls sig an F-algebra automorphism of E, but the Lean text types sig as E →ₐ[F] E, which is an F-algebra homomorphism and not an algebra equivalence.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.S.Loc.resChar
definitions.gloss: For a number field F and a height-one prime p of its ring of integers, this function returns the natural number given by the characteristic of the quotient ring of the ring of integers by the ideal of p.

definitions.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Dec
definitions.gloss: For a number field F, a field Ω that is an F-algebra, and a valuation subring A of Ω, this is the subgroup of G F Ω given by the Mathlib decomposition subgroup of A over F.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.OmegaDensity
definitions.gloss: For natural numbers P and Q, a measure μ on UpqT P Q and an extended nonnegative real c, this proposition says there is a measure lam on lieU P Q satisfying IsOmegaLeb such that, as r tends to 0 from above, the ratio of the μ-measure of the set of g whose matrix UpqT.mat g is the matrix exponential of some X in ballU P Q r to the lam-measure of ballU P Q r tends to c.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.UpqT
definitions.gloss: For natural numbers P and Q, this is the type Formalism.UG.Upq P Q, given a new name.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.sExp
definitions.gloss: For ranks R, a rational number ej and a natural number j, this function returns the rational number ej minus R.N (j - 1) divided by 2.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.sExp'
definitions.gloss: For ranks R, a rational number ej and a natural number j, this function returns the rational number ej minus R.N j divided by 2.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.HLat
definitions.gloss: For a number field K with a star operation, this is a record type with a vector space V over K that is also a module over the ring of integers of K compatibly, a finite index type ι with decidable equality, a basis b of V over K indexed by ι, a complex ι-by-ι matrix X for each infinite place of K, and a submodule L of V over the ring of integers of K.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.sFrame
definitions.gloss: For a family Nu of HLat K objects indexed by a finite type Words and a real function h on Words, this returns the real number obtained by summing over u the product of dU Nu u with (Nu u).mu minus h u, and dividing by Rsum Nu.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.HNeZero
definitions.gloss: For a host H over ranks R and a natural number p, this proposition says that for every prime ideal P of the ring of integers of H.E lying over the ideal generated by p and every ℚ-algebra automorphism σ of H.E that is an arithmetic Frobenius at P (in the sense of Mathlib IsArithFrobAt over ℤ), the order of the second component of H.galE σ is even.

definitions.name: Formalism.HermitianLatticesTheory.IsUnimodular
definitions.gloss: For a sesquilinear form h on a K-vector space V and an R-submodule L of V, this proposition says that the dual of L with respect to h, as given by dual h L, equals L.

definitions.name: Formalism.FrobeniusOrbits.NoRel
definitions.gloss: For a finite set T of natural numbers and a natural number L, this proposition says that for any three pairwise distinct elements s₁, s₂, s₃ of T and any distinct integers i and j with absolute values between 1 and L, the integer j times (s₂ - s₁) differs from i times (s₃ - s₁).

definitions.name: Formalism.HC.HostAx
definitions.gloss: For a frame φ, this record type extends HostRaw φ by one more field der, which is a proof of HostDer for the underlying HostRaw data.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.FinExt
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type of intermediate fields K between the l-adic numbers ℚ_[l] and Om l that are finite-dimensional over ℚ_[l].

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.Om
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type PadicAlgCl l from Mathlib, the algebraic closure of the l-adic numbers, given a new name.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.Ainf
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type of l-typical Witt vectors with coefficients in OCb l.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.GQ
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type of ℚ_[l]-algebra automorphisms of Om l.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.MaximalUnramifiedExtension
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the intermediate field of Om l over ℚ_[l] generated over ℚ_[l] by all elements x with x to the power m equal to 1 for some positive natural number m not divisible by l.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.OC
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type of elements of the Mathlib object PadicComplexInt l, viewed as a type.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.OCb
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type PreTilt (OC l) l from Mathlib, the pre-tilt of OC l at l.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.LocPrime
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is a record type with 27 fields. It bundles local rings R, period data PD K for every finite extension K in FinExt l, actions of GQ l on R.B and R.BdR, a Frobenius map φB, a map ιB from R.B to R.BdR, an element tB and a character χQ to the units of ℚ_[l], together with compatibility conditions making each PD K agree with these global objects, conditions on the action on the maximal unramified extension and on Om l, a near-Frobenius condition on PD K σ, a cyclotomic condition on χQ, a compatible system ζQ of l-power roots of unity with ζQ 0 = 1 and ζQ 1 ≠ 1, and valuations v on each finite extension with v of l equal to 1 and nonnegative exactly on OL.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.GK
definitions.gloss: For a finite extension K in FinExt l, this is the subgroup of GQ l consisting of the automorphisms that fix every element of K.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Loc.OL
definitions.gloss: For a finite extension LL in FinExt l, this is the integral closure of the l-adic integers ℤ_[l] in LL, as a ℤ_[l]-subalgebra of LL.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.Ainf
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type Reformulated.AutPerF.Ainf l (OC l), given a new name.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.Bcris
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type Reformulated.AutPerF.Bcris l (OC l), given a new name.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.BdR
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type Reformulated.AutPerF.BdR l (OC l), given a new name.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.BdRp
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the type BdRPlus l (OC l), given a new name.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.FilD
definitions.gloss: For a prime l and an integer a, this is the submodule BdR.fil l (OC l) a of BdR l, viewed as a module over BdRp l.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.IsCrisDR
definitions.gloss: For a ring map f from Bcris l to BdR l, this proposition has two parts. First, f sends a0B l a to pD l a for every a in Acris0 l. Second, for every natural number n there is N such that for every x in Acris l, the image under f of x is the image of some y in BdRp l, and ev l n applied to l to the power N times y equals the class of the image of some a in Ainf l inside AinfP l.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.IsLog
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, an element e of Fl l and an element y of BdRp l, this proposition says that for some proof h, y equals BdRPlus.log applied to the image of tm e in BdRPlus l (OC l) together with h.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.aB
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the ring map from Ainf l to Bcris l given by UpperTheory.Ring.Comp.aB l.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.zB
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the ring map from the l-adic integers ℤ_[l] to Bcris l given by UpperTheory.Ring.Comp.zB l.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.zD
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the ring map from the l-adic integers ℤ_[l] to BdR l given by UpperTheory.Ring.Comp.zD l.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.θD
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the ring map from BdRp l to the l-adic complex numbers ℂ_[l] given by BdRPlus.thetaC l (PadicComplexInt l).

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.σB
definitions.gloss: For an element g of Gq l, this is the ring map from Bcris l to itself given by Bcris.map applied to σO g and to the injectivity of the action of g.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.σD
definitions.gloss: For an element g of Gq l, this is the ring map from BdR l to itself given by UpperTheory.Ring.Comp.σD g.

definitions.name: Formalism.Per.φB
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the ring map from Bcris l to itself given by Bcris.frob l (OC l).

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.ColumnsAtT
definitions.gloss: For ranks R and a column chain C, this is a record type with 22 fields. It holds a prime T, a finite set vT with R.f elements, a finite field Fv v with T elements for each v, a nontrivial additive character psiT v of each Fv v, a homomorphism rhoT v from the units of Fv v to linear maps on the complex functions on C.cls 0 and C.Y 0, a finite-dimensional subspace Mu0 stable under all these maps, a positive natural number duStar, a positive real Dstar, and a real GamP greater than 1.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.DomWeight
definitions.gloss: For a natural number N, this is a record with two fields. The first is an integer vector w indexed by the N indices 0 to N−1. The second is a proof that w is antitone, which means its entries never increase as the index grows.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Rows.Places
definitions.gloss: For a field LL, this record describes a set of places. It has ten fields, namely a type Pl of places and, for each place, an additive valuation on LL with values in the integers extended by infinity, a conjugation map on places, a residue characteristic and a ramification index. The remaining fields are axioms. Conjugating twice gives back the same place, the residue characteristic is prime, the ramification index is positive, every integer is a value of the valuation, and the valuation of the residue characteristic, viewed in LL, equals the ramification index.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.hcToWeightQ
definitions.gloss: Given a rational vector hc indexed by the N indices 0 to N−1, this function returns the vector whose i-th entry is hc(i) − rhoVec(N, i). So it subtracts the vector rhoVec N entry by entry.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.intW
definitions.gloss: Given a place record Pl for a field LL and a place w, this is the subring of LL made of all x whose valuation at w is at least 0. The definition includes proofs that this set contains 0 and 1 and is closed under addition, negation and multiplication.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.wG
definitions.gloss: Given a ranks record R, a rational number ej and a natural number j, this function returns the rational number ej − k/2 − (2j − 1)(t + 1)/2. Here k and t are the fields of R with those names.

definitions.name: Formalism.HermitianLatticesTheory.majAt
definitions.gloss: This takes a basis b of a vector space V over a number field K with an involution, a family X of complex square matrices indexed by the infinite places of K, an infinite place v, and two vectors x and y. It returns the complex number given by summing, over the basis indices i, the complex conjugate of fcoord b X v x i times fcoord b X v y i.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.IsConjPl
definitions.gloss: For a host H and two height-one primes w and w' of the ring of integers of the field H.E, this proposition says the following. For all integers x and y of H.E with y equal to the conjugate H.conj of x, x lies in the ideal of w exactly when y lies in the ideal of w'.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.IsSplitPl
definitions.gloss: For a host H and a height-one prime v of the ring of integers of H.E, this proposition says there is an integer x lying in the ideal of v such that no integer y equal to the conjugate H.conj of x lies in the ideal of v.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.PlE
definitions.gloss: For a host H, this is an abbreviation for the type of height-one primes, that is the nonzero prime ideals, of the ring of integers of the field H.E.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.SplitOut
definitions.gloss: Given an NData record N, an index i of N.Loc and a prime w of H.E, this proposition says four things. The prime w is split in the sense of IsSplitPl, it is not among the places of H.E over the prime N.l i, and it lies in neither of the finite sets N.S i and N.Q i.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.heckePol
definitions.gloss: Given N, i, a point x of N.X i and a prime w of H.E, this function builds a polynomial over the ring N.O i. The polynomial is X^nV plus the sum over k from 1 to nV of (−1)^k · normV(w)^(k(k−1)/2) · (N.hT i w k evaluated at x) · X^(nV−k). Here nV is R.nV.

definitions.name: Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.G
definitions.gloss: For fields F and Ω with Ω an algebra over F, this is an abbreviation for the group of F-algebra automorphisms of Ω.

definitions.name: Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.IsFrob
definitions.gloss: For a valuation subring A of Ω, a natural number q and an automorphism σ in G F Ω, this proposition says two things. First, σ lies in the decomposition subgroup of A over F. Second, for every x whose A-valuation is at most 1, the valuation of σ(x) − x^q is strictly less than 1.

definitions.name: Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.IsPlaceOver
definitions.gloss: For a valuation subring A of Ω and a height-one prime v of the ring of integers of F, this proposition says the following. For every integer x of F, the A-valuation of the image of x in Ω is strictly less than 1 exactly when x lies in the ideal of v.

definitions.name: Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.Qbar
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is an abbreviation for PadicAlgCl l, the Mathlib algebraic closure of the l-adic numbers.

definitions.name: Formalism.ConjugateSelfDual.normV
definitions.gloss: For a height-one prime v of the ring of integers of F, this function returns the cardinality of the quotient of the ring of integers by the ideal of v, as a natural number.

definitions.name: Formalism.CyclotomicNorms.Fbar
definitions.gloss: For a prime g, this is an abbreviation for the algebraic closure of the field ZMod g of integers modulo g.

definitions.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.Ine
definitions.gloss: For a valuation subring A of Ω, this is the subgroup of G F Ω whose underlying set is Inertia A. The definition includes proofs that this set contains the identity and is closed under products and inverses.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.TameGenAt
definitions.gloss: For a valuation subring A of Ω and an automorphism γ in G E Ω, this proposition has two parts. The element γ lies in the inertia subgroup Ine A. In addition, Ine A lies inside the topological closure of the subgroup generated by γ together with all σ for which every nonzero y satisfies v(σ(y)/y − 1) < 1, where v is the A-valuation.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.heckeEig
definitions.gloss: This takes a domain O, a subalgebra T of the O-valued functions on a set X, an O-algebra map act from T to the endomorphisms of an O-module M, and a point x of X. It returns a submodule of M tensored with the fraction field of O. That submodule is the intersection, over all f in T, of the eigenspace of the base change of act(f) for the eigenvalue f(x).

definitions.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.LData
definitions.gloss: For a number field F, an algebraic closure Ω and a prime l, this record has six fields. It holds a finite set S of primes of F that equals the set Above F l, and for each v in S a valuation subring A v of Ω with IsPlaceOver (A v) v. It also holds a group homomorphism chi from GS Ω S to the units of the l-adic integers whose composition with toGS equals cycZ l.

definitions.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.Places
definitions.gloss: This is the type of functions A from height-one primes of the ring of integers of F to valuation subrings of Ω such that IsPlaceOver (A v) v holds for every v.

definitions.name: Formalism.GaloisCohomology.shaLen
definitions.gloss: Given D in LData F Ω l and an integer e, this function returns the length of the l-adic-integer module Sha D e. The value lies in the natural numbers extended by infinity.

definitions.name: ReciprocityTheory.Gal.cycZ
definitions.gloss: For a prime l, this is the group homomorphism from G F Ω to the units of the l-adic integers obtained by first sending each automorphism to the ring automorphism of Ω it induces and then applying the Mathlib cyclotomic character of Ω at l.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.AntiHom
definitions.gloss: Given a ring automorphism c of Ω and a group homomorphism φ from G E Ω to a commutative group, this proposition says the following. Whenever g' equals c ∘ g ∘ c⁻¹ pointwise, φ(g') equals the inverse of φ(g).

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.DelQM
definitions.gloss: For a host H, a natural number l, a finite set Q of primes of H.E and a natural number M, this is an abbreviation for the type of functions from the elements of Q to the integers modulo l^M.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.IsCMConjOm
definitions.gloss: For fields E and Ω with Ω an E-algebra and a ring automorphism c of Ω, this proposition has two parts. There is a ring map j from Ω to the complex numbers with j(c(x)) equal to the complex conjugate of j(x) for all x. In addition, c maps the image of E in Ω into itself.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.RamExactly
definitions.gloss: Given a group homomorphism φ from G E Ω to a group and a set Q of primes of E, this proposition concerns every prime v and every valuation subring A of Ω with IsPlaceOver A v. For each such pair, some element of the inertia subgroup Ine A has nontrivial image under φ exactly when v lies in Q.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Fb
definitions.gloss: Given a natural number l and a proof that l is prime, this is an abbreviation for Fbar l, the algebraic closure of the integers modulo l.

definitions.name: Formalism.CyclotomicNorms.BB
definitions.gloss: For natural numbers N and g, this is the set of natural numbers made of g together with every ℓ for which some d with 1 ≤ d ≤ N satisfies Exc g d ℓ.

definitions.name: Formalism.CyclotomicNorms.rootsBar
definitions.gloss: For a prime g and a polynomial f with coefficients in the integers modulo g, this function returns the multiset of roots of f, counted with multiplicity, in the algebraic closure Fbar g.

definitions.name: Formalism.HC.Frame
definitions.gloss: This record has seven fields. It holds natural numbers e and ord, an additive commutative group structure on Idx ord, and an additive homomorphism h0 from Idx ord to the additive form of HGrp e together with a proof that h0 is surjective. It also holds an element gen0 of Idx ord such that every integer multiple k·gen0 whose image under h0 is 0 is itself 0.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Rows.OLat
definitions.gloss: For a commutative ring O, a ring map φ from O to the complex numbers and a complex vector space V, this record has two fields. One is a finite set gen of vectors in V, and the other is a proof that gen spans V over the complex numbers. The parameters O and φ do not appear in the fields.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.IsSDLat
definitions.gloss: For a number field E with an involution, a natural number N and a submodule L of E^N over the ring of integers of E, this proposition has three parts. L is finitely generated, it spans E^N over E, and a vector y lies in L exactly when stdH E N x y is an integer of E for every x in L.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.CMData
definitions.gloss: For number fields F and E with E an F-algebra and E carrying an involution star, this record of propositions has four fields. E satisfies IsCMUnram, F is totally real, E has dimension 2 over F, and an element a of E satisfies star a = a exactly when a lies in the image of F.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.HSpace.IsIsomEmb
definitions.gloss: For two HSpace records S and S' over E and an E-linear map ι from S.V to S'.V, this proposition says that S'.hT(ι x, ι y) = S.hT(x, y) for all x and y. In other words ι preserves the forms hT.

definitions.name: Formalism.HermitianLatticesTheory.IsOrthoLattice
definitions.gloss: Given a sesquilinear form h on a vector space V over a number field K, a submodule L over the ring of integers of K and a natural number n, this proposition says there are vectors e(0), …, e(n−1) with four properties. They are linearly independent over K, they span V over K, L is their span over the ring of integers, and h(e i, e j) is 1 when i = j and 0 otherwise.

definitions.name: Formalism.UG.cT
definitions.gloss: Given a ring endomorphism σ of a commutative ring A and a matrix M with rows indexed by m and columns by p, this function returns the matrix with rows indexed by p and columns by m obtained by applying σ to every entry of M and then transposing.

definitions.name: Formalism.UG.inclE
definitions.gloss: For an F-algebra R, this is the ring map from E to the tensor product of E and R over F that sends e to e ⊗ 1. It is the Mathlib inclusion of the left factor.

definitions.name: Formalism.UG.sigR
definitions.gloss: Given an F-algebra map σ from E to E and an F-algebra R, this is the ring endomorphism of the tensor product of E and R over F that applies σ on the E factor and the identity on the R factor.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.JetLoc
definitions.gloss: A record type with ten fields. It holds a natural number l with a proof that l is prime and that 5 ≤ l, a natural number d with proofs that d is nonzero, even and at least 2, two natural numbers N0 and N1, and a multivariable formal power series Th with coefficients in the l-adic complex numbers ℂ_[l] whose variables are indexed by ZMod d × Fin N0 × Fin N1.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.JetLoc1
definitions.gloss: A record type with six fields. It holds a natural number l with a proof that l is prime and that 5 ≤ l, two natural numbers N0 and N1, and a multivariable formal power series Th with coefficients in ℂ_[l] whose variables are indexed by ZMod 1 × Fin N0 × Fin N1.

definitions.name: Formalism.HermitianLatticesTheory.cnorm
definitions.gloss: A function that sends a complex vector u indexed by a finite set ι to the real number given by the square root of the sum over i of ‖u i‖ squared. This is the standard Euclidean length of u.

definitions.name: Formalism.HermitianLatticesTheory.fcoord
definitions.gloss: A function that takes a basis b of the K-vector space V, a family X of square complex matrices indexed by the infinite places of the number field K, an infinite place v and a vector x of V. It returns the complex vector obtained by multiplying the inverse of the matrix X v with vecAt b v x, which is the vector of coordinates of x in the basis b sent into ℂ by the embedding of v.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.Level
definitions.gloss: A record type attached to a datum P of type Places, with four fields. It holds a type Γ with a group structure, for every index v a group homomorphism from Γ to the invertible (P.m + 1) by (P.m + 1) matrices over the field P.Qq v, and a group homomorphism χ from Γ to the units of the ring O.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.Places
definitions.gloss: A record type with eighteen fields, depending on a natural number p, a discrete valuation ring O and a field Kf that is an O-algebra. It holds an element w of O and a count nV, and for each index v below nV a natural number n' v, a discrete valuation ring W v with an algebra map to a field Qq v, ring maps ι v from Qq v to Kf and j v from W v to O, a ring automorphism σ v of Qq v, and a proof that these data satisfy HidaSetting. It also holds natural numbers m and r and, for each v, an integer array lam0 v indexed by Fin (n' v) × Fin (m + 1) with a proof that it is IsDominant, which means that each of its rows is antitone.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.HasParamW
definitions.gloss: A proposition about an index i of N.Loc, an element σ of what₂.FT and a list Sig of parts. It states that every part in Sig has a ≥ 1 and d ≥ 1, that rankIso of Sig (the sum of the products a times d) equals R.r, and that for every place w of H.E with IsSplitPl H w the local object isoLoc N A Sig w equals A.locW i σ w.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.iotaOQ
definitions.gloss: A ring homomorphism from the ring N.O i to Qbar (N.l i), which is the Mathlib algebraic closure PadicAlgCl of the (N.l i)-adic numbers. It is the canonical map from N.O i into its fraction ring followed by the map A.iotaQ i.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.mapRep
definitions.gloss: A function that takes a ring homomorphism f from A to B and a group homomorphism ρ from Γ to the invertible a by a matrices over A. It returns the group homomorphism from Γ to the invertible a by a matrices over B obtained by applying f to every entry of each matrix ρ g.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.IsBCV
definitions.gloss: A proposition about an index i, an element P of A.AV i and a list Pa of parts, made of six conditions. Every part has a ≥ 1 and d ≥ 1 and satisfies A.csd, the pairs formed by (a, π) and d are pairwise distinct, and rankIso of Pa equals R.nV. At every split place w the value isoLoc N A Pa w equals A.locV i P w, and at every non-split place A.unr holds for isoLoc N A Pa w and A.frobEig of it equals ubc R.nV (A.satV i P w), where ubc n α adds to the multiset α the inverses of its elements and also 1 when n is odd, and for every ring embedding τ of H.E into ℂ the multiset isoInf N A Pa τ equals A.infWt i τ.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.isoLoc
definitions.gloss: A function that sends a list P of parts and a place w of H.E to an element of A.LP w. It folds the list from the right, starting from A.lpZero w and using A.lpSum to add the term spehLoc N A p w for each part p. Here spehLoc itself uses A.lpSum to add up the twists by A.lpTw of A.locG p.π w by the shifts (d − 1)/2 − k for k from 0 to d − 1.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.muPart
definitions.gloss: For an index i, the part with a equal to 1, π equal to A.muC i and d equal to R.t.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.twistIso
definitions.gloss: A function that takes a list P of parts and an element χ of A.CG 1. It returns the list in which each part with data a, π, d is replaced by the part with data a, A.tw π χ, d.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.IsRepOfSig
definitions.gloss: A proposition about an index i, a list Sig of parts and a group homomorphism ρ from G H.E N.Om, the group of field automorphisms of N.Om over H.E, to the invertible R.r by R.r matrices over N.O i. It states that ρ is continuous as a matrix-valued map, and that ρ composed with the map into the fraction ring Kf N i is semisimple in the sense of IsSSRep. It also states that for all but finitely many places w of H.E, for every valuation subring B of N.Om lying over w and every σ that is a Frobenius for B with q equal to normV w, the characteristic polynomial of ρ σ sent to ℂ by iotaO N A i equals galPol A of A.lpTw (isoLoc N A Sig w) ((1 − R.r)/2), which is the product of X − α over the multiset A.frobEig of that element.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.IsSSRep
definitions.gloss: A proposition about a group homomorphism ρ from Γ to the invertible a by a matrices over a field k. It states that every subspace W of k^a that is invariant under all matrices ρ g has an invariant complement W', which is an invariant subspace with W ⊕ W' equal to k^a.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.fbCast
definitions.gloss: A function that takes natural numbers p and q with a proof that p = q and proofs that both are prime. It returns a ring isomorphism from Fb p hp to Fb q hq, which is the identity isomorphism once q is replaced by p.

definitions.name: Formalism.BasicNotions.Part
definitions.gloss: A record type with three fields, depending on a family CG of types indexed by natural numbers. It holds a natural number a, an element π of CG a, and a natural number d.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.HasParamX
definitions.gloss: A proposition about an index i, an element x of N.X i and a list Sig of parts. It states that there is some P with A.ptV i P equal to some x such that IsBCV N A i P holds for a list built in two steps. That list is Sig followed by muPart N A i, with every part then twisted by A.etaTinv through twistIso.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.N.goodSig
definitions.gloss: A proposition about a list Sig of parts. It states that for each k the condition IsGood holds with degree R.r, prime H.g k, the characters N.chiT k, and the family of polynomials over ZMod (H.g k) sending v to A.items₂ k (A.plGw k v) (isoLoc N A Sig (A.plGw k v)). It also states that IsGood holds for the same polynomials with the pointwise inverses of these characters.

definitions.name: Formalism.MainNotions.S.Loc.LocAt
definitions.gloss: A record type with thirty-two fields that gives local data at a prime p of the integers of F, for an extension E of number fields over F with an F-automorphism sig. It holds a nonarchimedean local field Fp of characteristic zero and an Fp-algebra Ep that is free of rank 2, with their topological, valuative and measurable structures, dense and compatible embeddings of F and E whose valuation matches that of p, and an Fp-automorphism cj of Ep extending sig. It further holds the subring O of elements of Ep integral over the integers of Fp, a proof that resChar p is prime and that Fp is a continuous finite-dimensional algebra over ℚ_[resChar p], an additive character psiE of Ep with psiE y equal to exp(2πi a) for a rational a whose denominator is a power of resChar p and which lies within distance 1 of the trace of y, and an optional SplitAt datum.
